refreshNotes: EC40 returns to the US market for MY2026 after skipping MY2025 — the model was renamed from C40 Recharge as part of Volvo's BEV naming refresh. Mechanically the EC40 is the EX40 with a fastback roofline. Same CMA platform, same Single Motor / Twin Motor powertrain options. Source: https://www.kbb.com/volvo/ec40/, https://www.cars.com/research/volvo-ec40-2025/
